We replace $x$ with $3$ in the given expression, and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{3x-1} & = \\ \sqrt{3\cdot 3-1} & = \\ \sqrt{9-1} & = \\ \sqrt{8} & \end{aligned}
$$

We can simplify even further using the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{8} & = \\ \sqrt{4\cdot 2} & = \\ \sqrt{{2}^{2}\cdot 2} & = \\ \sqrt{{2}^{2}}\cdot \sqrt{2} & = \\ 2\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}
$$
